verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for a software platform, so the axis applies. Every item in the pack describes Stripe Issuing as a Stripe-hosted API and Dashboard service. Nothing documents a self-hostable or on-premises deployment of the core product. The MCP server and CLI are developer tools for the hosted API, not a self-hosted product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
